competitors.name: Miro / Mural
competitors.summary: Collaborative digital whiteboards with AI clustering and templates.
competitors.differentiator: Focuses on static post-it canvas rather than real-time voice-driven agentic tool calling.

competitors.name: Otter.ai / Fireflies
competitors.differentiator: Only records transcripts and summaries, does not synthesize ideas or spawn autonomous subagents.

competitors.name: Whimsical AI
competitors.summary: AI mind mapping and flowcharts generated from text prompts.
competitors.differentiator: Requires manual prompt typing rather than continuous conversational transcription.

market_landscape: The market is split between passive meeting recorders and static whiteboards. An active agentic brainstorming companion creates a distinct new category.
our_positioning: We position ourselves as an active AI co-founder during brainstorming: listening continuously, identifying distinct ideas, and autonomously dispatching research and workflow agents.
